529-3197-5434-8181.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, causing you to surveil 1.
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

678-5670-6273--52.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
678-5670-6273--52.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
When the creature dies, Embalmed Ascendant and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two lore counters on it

957-3277-7879.easyPrerequisites: You have at least eight cards in hand.
957-3277-7879.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, The Great Synthesis triggers, putting a lore counter on it. Its third chapter ability then triggers, causing you to cast Time Stretch and Izzet Chronarch without paying their mana costs, and then exiling The Great Synthesis and returning it to the battlefield as Jin-Gitaxias.
Resolve Time Stretch, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Resolve the Izzet Chronarch spell. When it enters, it triggers, returning Time Stretch from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Jin-Gitaxias by paying {3}{U}, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as The Great Synthesis.
When The Great Synthesis enters with a lore counter on it, its first ability triggers, causing you to draw cards equal to the number of cards in your hand and not have a maximum hand size for the rest of the game.
Move to your first extra turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, The Great Synthesis triggers, putting a lore counter on it. Its second chapter ability then triggers, returning all non-Phyrexian creatures (including Izzet Chronarch) from the battlefield to their owner's hand.
Repeat from step 1 during your second extra turn
957-3277-7879.notes: The combo is listed as near-infinite turns because you'll draw cards at a much faster rate than normal, which will result in you getting less turns.

2204-5231-6972.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Scholar of New Horizons.
When Scholar of New Horizons dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

1453-5686--5.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Arwen
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat

240-997-5929.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as an Egg due to Leyline of Transformation, Atla triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat as desired / able.
240-997-5929.notes: The combo can continue as long as there are creature cards in your library.

774-1362-3875.description:
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting Oboro, Palace in the Clouds from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
When Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters the battlefield, Tireless Provisioner triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Oboro's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Oboro's last ability by paying {1}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

3490-4050-5070-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4050-5070-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

24-4090-7167.description:
Cast Wheel of Misfortune by paying {2}{R}, choosing an arbitrarily large number and having Wheel of Misfortune deal that much damage to Wrathful Raptors instead of you due to Pariah if you chose the largest number.
Wrathful Raptors triggers, dealing that much damage to an applicable target.
24-4090-7167.notes: If you didn't choose the highest number, Wheel of Misfortune will deal damage to the opponent(s) who did equal to that number.

176-560-3967.easyPrerequisites: You control an additional non-Spirit creature.
176-560-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing a non-Spirit creature
When the creature dies, Requiem Angel triggers, creating two creature tokens due to Queen Allenal of Ruadach.
Resolve the Yahenni ability
Repeat.

457-1329-1594-3338-7112.description:
If Aether Spellbomb is in your graveyard, activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Aether Spellbomb.
Cast Aether Spellbomb either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Helm of Awakening.
Mirran Spy triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Aether Spellbomb, adding {U}.
Activate Aether Spellbomb's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing it, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

7-4046-7070.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures that each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
7-4046-7070.description:
Activate Outrider en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Outrider en-Kor.
The Outrider en-Kor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Outrider en-Kor from exile by paying {0} due to Hamza.
Repeat.

5329-5475-7014.description:
Activate either of the creatures by tapping it, targeting the other creature.
If the tapped creature was a Merfolk, Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the ability from step 1, untapping the targeted creature.
Repeat.

392-3532-5078-6607.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Lorescale Coatl triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Repeat.

2921-3771-4484-4871-5643.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
2921-3771-4484-4871-5643.notablePrerequisites: Animar has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
2921-3771-4484-4871-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability and Animar trigger.
Resolve the Animar trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Resolve the Geralf trigger, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Bartolomé del Presidio abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
2921-3771-4484-4871-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

1580-2292-4871-5334.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

5078-5642-6556.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
Echoes of Eternity triggers, creating a copy of the Sensei's Divining Top spell.
Resolve both Sensei's Divining Top spells.
Activate the nontoken Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate the token Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top, and causing you to put the token Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

5149-5200-5985.easyPrerequisites: Power Artifact attached to Sword of the Paruns.
5149-5200-5985.notablePrerequisites:
Ulvenwald Abomination does not have summoning sickness.
Sword of the Paruns attached to Ulvenwald Abomination
5149-5200-5985.description:
Activate Ulvenwald Abomination by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {1}, untapping Ulvenwald Abomination.
Repeat.
5149-5200-5985.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may attach Sword of the Paruns to any other creature(s) to untap them.

1961-2793-4868-5089.description:
Activate Throne of Geth by tapping it and sacrificing Ugin's Nexus.
Ugin's Nexus is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Throne of Geth ability, putting two loyalty counters on Karn.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
Repeat.

2034-2557-4716-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Prosperous Innkeeper, adding {C}{C}.
When Prosperous Innkeeper dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Prosperous Innkeeper from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Prosperous Innkeeper enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat.

3764-4321.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Foods.
3764-4321.description:
Activate Peregrin Took by sacrificing three Foods.
Summoning Station triggers three times.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping it.
Activate Summoning Station by tapping it, creating a 2/2 Pincher creature token and a Food artifact token.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Resolve the Peregrin Took ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

2191-3799-5109.notablePrerequisites: Any opponent chosen with Stuffy Doll.
2191-3799-5109.description:
Cast Martyrdom by paying {1}{W}{W}, targeting Stuffy Doll.
Cast Volcano Hellion by paying {2}{R}{R}.
Volcano Hellion enters the battlefield, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Stuffy Doll by paying {0}, causing the next one damage dealt to you to be dealt to Stuffy Doll instead.
Repeat step 4 an arbitrarily large number of times.
Resolve the Volcano Hellion trigger from step 3, dealing an arbitrarily large amount of damage to Stuffy Doll.
Stuffy Doll triggers, dealing an arbitarily large amount of damage to target opponent.

2034-2757-4573.notablePrerequisites: At least 1 basic land under your control.
2034-2757-4573.description:
Activate Sacred Mesa to create a 1/1 pegasus creature.
Activate Earthcraft to tap the token and untap a basic land.
Tap the land for mana.
Sacrifice the token for {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1368-1414-3075-4856.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one experience counter.
You have a storm count of at least one.
1368-1414-3075-4856.description:
Activate Lotus Petal by sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Brain Freeze by paying {U}, targeting yourself.
If you have less than two experience counters, Mizzix triggers, causing you to get an experience counter.
Brain Freeze's storm ability triggers, creating a copy of Brain Freeze for each other spell you've cast this turn, with one copy targeting yourself and all remaining copies targeting any player.
Resolve all Brain Freeze spells, causing yourself to mill six cards and all other targeted players to mill three cards for each Brain Freeze.
Cast Lotus Petal from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {0} and exiling three cards from your graveyard.
Activate Lotus Petal by sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Brain Freeze from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {U} and exiling three cards from your graveyard, targeting yourself.
Repeat from step 4.
